title: DC-area forecast: Cooler and rather cloudy today with an early shower; rain chances rise late Saturday
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: A lingering morning shower is possible, especially before 9 a.m. Clouds should outnumber sunnier moments, but more sun may break through in the afternoon with highs near 80 to the mid-80s.

What's next? An occasional shower is possible Saturday until scattered showers and storms become likely by late afternoon or evening. Some improvement Sunday, with comfortable weather settling in Monday and Tuesday.

Today’s daily digit — 6/10: Cooler and more comfortable, but a lingering early shower, humidity, and plentiful clouds keep it from being a standout. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Friday): A solid step down from recent heat, with highs near 80 to the mid-80s. Mostly cloudy with the chance of a lingering morning shower, then just a bit less humid the rest of the day as dew points dip to the mid-60s. Clouds may still dominate despite some increased afternoon sun. Confidence: Medium

Tonight: Mostly cloudy with an isolated shower possible, mainly after midnight. Lows in the 60s to around 70 downtown. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Saturday: An occasional light shower is possible during the morning into early afternoon as highs shoot for the upper 70s to low 80s. The chance for scattered showers and storms rises by late afternoon or evening. Confidence: Medium

Saturday night: Showers are likely, with a thunderstorm possible, during the evening into overnight, then tapering to a lingering shower chance by dawn. Very muggy with lows near 70 to the mid-70s. Confidence: Medium

Sunday: A shower could linger early. Otherwise turning sunnier through midday and afternoon with highs reaching the low and mid-80s. Perhaps an additional late-day shower or storm, mainly east and south of DC. Confidence: Medium

A look ahead

Sunday night: Partly cloudy with a slow decrease in humidity. Lows in the mid-60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium

A nicer stretch Monday and Tuesday. There could be a passing shower Monday with a weak front, then mostly sunny skies, low humidity, and highs in the upper 70s to mid-80s. Comfortably cool overnight lows in the mid-50s to mid-60s. Confidence: Low-Medium

Temperatures trend back up by Wednesday and Thursday, with highs potentially climbing to the upper 80s to near 90 both days as humidity slowly increases again. There's also a slight chance of a shower or storm creeping back in. Confidence: Low-Medium

DC weather history for September 11

Striking contrasts define this date, from record heat in 1983 to record early-season chill in 1917, while in 2001 it was a clear, calm day overshadowed by historic tragedy.
